fixed.explanation: filterCookies suffix-matched domains even for host-only cookies and used a bare startsWith for paths. It now requires an exact hostname match for host-only cookies and applies the RFC 6265 path-match rule. pathMatches no longer appends '/' to the request path, so a /foo/ cookie doesn't match /foo, and it uses the same rule.

query.intent: Cookie filtering by URL in the browser context cookie store: the domain match, path match, and secure checks used when returning cookies for URLs or when deciding which cookies to send. Domain matching must treat host-only cookies as exact host matches, and path matching must follow RFC 6265 path-match rules (prefix must end at a '/' boundary).
query.symptom: Cookie URL matching is wrong: host-only cookies are returned for subdomains, a /api cookie matches /apiv2, and a /foo/ cookie is sent to /foo.

history.analysis: filterCookies in network.ts uses a suffix match on the domain, so host-only cookies match subdomains. It also uses a plain startsWith for the path, so /api matches /apiv2. pathMatches in cookieStore.ts appends '/' to both sides, so a /foo/ cookie matches /foo. domainMatches looks correct for host-only cookies.
